scope: HITL-003 public HTTP/SDK authorization matrix with an injected fake approval clock. It covers only the state-backed public contract; it is not a PostgreSQL/MinIO, Temporal-process, Workspace service, sandbox, Firecracker, Linux/KVM, or browser claim.

observations.owner_authorization: The owner reads and approves a caller-owned pending Approval through public HTTP/SDK; a second identical decision idempotently replays the same terminal result.
observations.safe_denial_and_scope: A cross-principal read/decision receives the safe not-found result, and an attempt to submit a grant-shaped scope change is rejected as invalid input rather than broadening authority.
observations.fake_clock_expiry: Advancing the injected clock makes a late public decision conflict and leaves the Tool undispatched; explicit denial also leaves the Tool undispatched.

redaction: No bearer tokens, raw tenant/session/turn/approval IDs, action descriptors, capability values, grants, backend handles, or provider credentials are retained.
